blogTitle: dispatches from the college level (for people still in high school. you'll get here)
about: hey. trevor. freshman at lakeview state (go herons). i'm on thefacebook, which is a website for college students only. you need a .edu address to get in, so everybody on it is an adult with a future. it's clean. there's no glitter. nobody's song starts by itself. so i'm only on ourspace ironically, like an alumnus, checking in on some people from home. is it for kids? it's for kids. i say that with love. i log in once a day. ok it's more. it's research. i live in a building with a name (henley hall) with a roommate named brent who i've met 3 times. we respect each other's independence. at the college level you learn to be alone with a lot of people. it's a skill. i'm getting good.
aboutMore: updates from campus: intro to philosophy (prof halvorsen asked 'what is a friend' and i said 'someone in your top 8' and he wrote on the board for 11 minutes). intramural flag football, THE DEAN'S LIST, 0-6 (we've scored one time. it was a gift). i call my mom sundays at 6. it's scheduled. it's not homesickness, it's a calendar. she's watched my graduation trailer 11 times. she says the cross dissolve is where she cries. i've watched it once. at 2 AM. for research.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: a girl in my philosophy section named Priya who laughed at one of my points (i'm not sure it was a joke) (it was a point). my RA derrick, who has a whiteboard and no friends on it. whoever invented the poke, so i can ask what it MEANS (everyone says 'nothing, that's the feature'). and everybody from home, in person, when it's not weird. (it's not weird.)

interests.General: college (the level), thefacebook (college only), the cereal dispenser, flag football (0-6), floor meetings on thursdays (attendance: me), being in 14 groups (one is a waffle group, i founded it, 6 members), laundry day (a skill), calling my mom (sundays, 6 PM, scheduled), saving seats
interests.Music: jack johnson (the whole album. it's for studying), dave matthews band (a requirement, i've been told), the killers, coldplay (i'm 'discovering' it), whatever brent plays when he's here (he's never here, so it's mostly rumor)
interests.Movies: garden state (everybody on my floor has seen it and we all feel the same about it), old school (we quote it in the dining hall in unison and none of us know each other), good will hunting (for philosophy), the sandlot (a field. a friend group. not relevant.)
interests.Television: the office (thursdays in the lounge, i'm on the beanbag by the door), scrubs, the weather channel in the laundry room (it's what's on), jeopardy with my mom on the phone (she says the answers, i say them back, we both win)
interests.Books: intro to philosophy reader (spiral bound, $64), the syllabus (3 pages, read twice), catcher in the rye (every freshman owns the same copy), the thefacebook terms of use (i read all of it. nobody else did)
interests.Heroes: my mom, professor halvorsen, my RA derrick (he's trying), chad (can't work a computer, nicest guy i know), the dining hall lady who says 'have a good one' and means it

keywords.college: it's a lot of freedom. my first week i stayed up until 2 AM on a tuesday for no reason. just because. that's college. i then slept through a 9 AM and learned a lot about myself.
keywords.facebook: thefacebook. it's like this but clean, and you need a .edu to get in, so it's just people who are going places. there's a wall and pokes. very mature. i have 86 friends. 83 are from my floor. 3 are the dining hall guy.
keywords.poke: a poke is when you poke someone. it doesn't mean anything. that's the feature. i've been poked 4 times by the same guy. his name is dale. we've never spoken. he pokes every day at 4. i've started to wait for it.
keywords.dorm: henley hall, third floor. it has a name AND a number. my room has 2 beds, 2 desks, and a window that looks at a different dorm. the other dorm has a name too. they're all named after people nobody's heard of.
keywords.mom: she calls on sundays. i mean i call her. sundays at 6. it's a scheduled call. i know her number by heart, it's the same as the house. i know that. it's not a big deal.
keywords.kids: ok i said 'kids.' i meant it nicely. i mean people who still have a locker. i'm not saying i don't miss my locker (114, top row). i'm saying it's behind me. a long way behind me. i drove 90 minutes.
keywords.high school: high school was fine. everybody knew my name. here nobody does. it's like being a new kid but the new kid is everyone and there's no one to look at your pic and say hey that's trevor

bulletins.subject: PSA from the college level (re: ourspace being 'for kids')
bulletins.body: ok. i said it and i meant it. i'm not taking it back. but a clarification, because 4 people messaged me: 'for kids' is not an insult. it's a category. like 'for dogs.' i love dogs. i'm just not a dog. i'm saying this site is for people who still have a locker, a bedtime and a mom who yells up the stairs. and i'm saying i checked it 9 times today. those are two different statements and they can both be true. that's philosophy. i took a class. p.s. if you're a junior or a senior reading this: it gets bigger. it also gets quieter. enjoy the loud.

blog.title: things nobody tells you about college (a guide for juniors who are mature enough to read it)
blog.body: 1) there's a cereal dispenser. it's free. it's more than you think. 2) your roommate might be a rumor. mine is real but i've seen him 3 times, so, rumor. 3) everyone is also pretending. this one took me 3 weeks and a laundry room. a guy on my floor said 'i don't know anyone either' while folding a towel. we're now acquaintances. 4) laundry takes 2 hours and nobody tells you that the 2 hours are for thinking. 5) the phone call home gets shorter and then it gets longer. mine was 11 minutes in august. now it's 40. my mom says it's because she has more to tell me. she doesn't. 6) you will find a website that has everyone you know on it and you'll leave it open in the second tab. that's all. that's the whole list.

blog.title: my graduation trailer (a review)
blog.body: so miles made me a trailer for my graduation. 52 seconds. opens on black. a slow zoom on me in the gown. a cross dissolve to me walking across the stage. then a cross dissolve to me walking across the stage again, from a different angle, because he only had two photos and one was a mistake. the title flies in. it says TREVOR: THE NEXT CHAPTER. the music is a loop called 'Inspire 04.' my mom has watched it 11 times. she says it's 'our song.' i don't know what 'our' is. i watched it once, at 2 AM, in my dorm, with the sound off, and then with the sound on. in the second photo, behind me, you can see chad. he's in the bleachers. he's holding a sign. the sign says GO TREVOR. in caps. i didn't know that. i watched it 4 more times.
